vizulla.metaTitle: Vizulla Browser — yihuta, yizewe kandi ni ubuntu
vizulla.metaDescription: Kuramo Vizulla, mushakisha yihuta kandi irinda ubuzima bwite ya Universal Bridge: ihagarika amatangazo n'ababakurikirana, ifite umufasha ukorera kuri mudasobwa, ibika ijambo ry'ibanga na porofayili. Ni ubuntu kuri macOS, Windows na Linux.
vizulla.title: Vizulla Browser
vizulla.lead: Ihagarika amatangazo n'ababakurikirana, ibika neza amagambo y'ibanga kandi ifite umufasha ukorera kuri mudasobwa yawe. Ni ubuntu, mu ndimi enye.

languages.title: Ivuga ururimi rwawe
languages.body: Koresha Vizulla mu Cyongereza, Igiswahili, Igifaransa cyangwa Ikinyarwanda. Imbuga za interineti na zo zibwirwa ururimi rwawe.

install.title: Shyiramo Vizulla mu ntambwe eshatu
install.lead: Hitamo sisitemu yawe. Nyuma yaho Vizulla yivugurura ubwayo: buto yo kuvugurura igaragara mu mwanya w'ibikoresho iyo verisiyo nshya isohotse.

s1.title: Fungura icyo wakuyemo
s1.body: Kanda kabiri kuri dosiye ya .dmg iri muri Downloads.

s2.title: Kurura Vizulla ujyane muri Applications
s2.body: Kurura ikimenyetso cya Vizulla ugishyire kuri Applications, hanyuma ukuremo installer.

s3.title: Yifungure ku nshuro ya mbere
s3.body: macOS isaba kwemeza porogaramu zitavuye muri App Store. Fungura Vizulla, kanda Done, hanyuma ujye muri System Settings → Privacy & Security ukande Open Anyway. Ubikora rimwe gusa.

s1.title: Tangiza installer
s1.body: Fungura dosiye ya .exe iri muri Downloads.

s2.title: Emeza porogaramu
s2.body: Niba Windows yerekanye "Windows protected your PC", kanda More info, hanyuma Run anyway.

s3.title: Tangira gushakisha
s3.body: Vizulla irafunguka iyo kuyishyiramo birangiye, kandi ishyira ikimenyetso muri Start menu.

s1.title: Yemerere gukora
s1.body: Kanda iburyo kuri AppImage, ufungure Properties, ufungure Allow executing as program.

s2.title: Fungura Vizulla
s2.body: Kanda kabiri kuri AppImage. Ukoresha paki ya .deb? Yifungure ukoresheje porogaramu yawe yo gushyiramo software.

s3.title: Guma ku gihe
s3.body: AppImage yivugurura ubwayo. Ku paki ya .deb, shyiramo verisiyo nshya uvuye kuri iyi paji.
